about: The reference board (docs/ART.md is the bar it measures against): the probe's views from ci/scene.sh, each beside the reference frames ART.md measured, and the operator's marks. The reference set is the reference game's screenshots, so it never enters this repo: point GATES_REFERENCE_DIR at your own copy, as for ci/native_bar.py. node ci/board.mjs look shoots every view and draws the sheet; it scores nothing. The fx-* views are the fx stage's strips (ci/fx.sh, the fx skill): one effect over a dark and a light card, every frame of it, measured against the plate and the last run.

views.name: Effect: a round on metal
views.what: bullet × metal on the fx stage: dark card left, light card right, 1.4 s
views.take: a white-hot star for a frame or two, sparks that streak and cool white → ember, skitter once off the plate and are gone by 0.5 s; one small grey puff; reads with bloom off

views.name: Effect: a round on stone
views.what: bullet × stone on the fx stage

views.name: Effect: a round on wood

views.name: Effect: a round into water

views.name: Effect: a swing at stone

views.name: Effect: a satchel going off
views.what: the blast on the fx stage, framed for 2.2 m, 3 s
views.take: a flash, an orange fireball that cools to red in half a second, sparks, then smoke that rises and hangs; the light card shows the smoke's body
